data: What is the approximate value of the black line in the right plot for year 1998?

The right plot shows the mean relative overlap over time. To find the approximate value of the black line in the right plot for year 1998:

1. Locate the year 1998 on the x-axis of the right plot.
2. Observe where the black line intersects with the y-axis for that year.
3. Estimate the value based on the scale provided on the y-axis.

The black line appears to be slightly above 0.0055 on the y-axis for the year 1998.
